description_en: Registers devices in batches based on an application batch ID (ApplyId)
description_zh: 根据申请批次ID（ApplyId）批量注册设备
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-register-device-with-apply-id --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --apply-id 1295006 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchRegisterDeviceWithApplyId

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter has a value, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter has no value, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices that you want to register in batches belong
parameters.help_zh: 要批量注册的设备所属的产品ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The application batch ID of the devices that you want to register in batches. The application batch ID is generated by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69482.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 要批量注册的设备的申请批次ID。申请批次ID由调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69482.html接口生成
parameters.name: apply_id
